campaign.HF_Text1: A communication was received at your personal pad, and after a thorough check by your communications staff, it was confirmed that the signal came from within the Fleet.
campaign.HF_Text2: "After the connection is established, the other party does not respond."
campaign.HF_Option2: Cut comm-link and send message to the Fleet that the perpetrator of this prank will be severely punished.
campaign.HF_Text3: After accepting the request for communication, you're surprised to find that the communicator is your own First Officer, but there is another First Officer who look exactly like them.
campaign.HF_Text4: “Uhn? It's not connected yet? Isn't that what Hanliu person said how you'd operate this?”
campaign.HF_Text5: “Hey! It's working! that person really didn't lie to me this time.”
campaign.HF_Text7: You turn your head to look at your First Officer, Their face is also filled with surprise.
campaign.HF_Text8: Your First Officer is flustered, seemingly trying to explain.
campaign.HF_Option3: Interrupt the First Officer and wait to see what ‘Fake First Officer’ is going to do.
campaign.HF_Option4: Listen to your First Officer's Explanation.
campaign.HF_Option5: Let the guards subdue the First Officer beside you
campaign.HF_ST1_1: ”It's... IT'S AN EMERGENCY!! This won't do, saying random stuff will cause problems...ahhhhh”
campaign.HF_ST1_2: The ”First Officer“ on the other end of the comm is looking a bit uncomfortable, and you recognized the background of their comm image, it is your flagship.
campaign.HF_ST1_3: Contact your Ship's Security quietly and quickly take control of the First Officers location
campaign.HF_ST2_1: The First Officer beside you is relieved, and without wiping sweat on their forehead. they hastily begins to tell their long-winded explanation, which is basically just how loyal they're toward you and how they proved themselves to be the real one.
campaign.HF_ST2_2: Gesture to show you've got it and quietly contact your ship's security to quickly take control of the 'First Officer' 's Location
campaign.HF_ST2_3: Let the guards subdue the First Officer beside you
campaign.HF_ST3_1: Your guards immediately put the First Officer's hands behind their back and pinned them to the ground, while the First Officer is begging to give you an explanation.
campaign.HF_ST3_2: On the other side, the 'First Officer' seems to realize they have made a big mess
campaign.HF_ST3_3: With a distortion on the Comm-Link Screen, the 'First Officer' over the comm-link had became a young girl with white hair and blue eyes.
campaign.HF_ST3_4: Explain where you come from and what you're doing.
campaign.HF_TX_1: The other side noticed the moment you sent the  message.n
campaign.HF_TX_2: On the other side, the 'First Officer' seems to realize they have made a big mess
campaign.HF_TX_3: With a distortion on the Comm-Link Screen, the 'First Officer' over the comm-link had became a young girl with white hair and blue eyes.
campaign.HF_TX_4: Explain where you come from and what you're doing.
campaign.HF_TXT_1: “Ok ok! I'll admit it! I am not your first officer, stop asking already!”
campaign.HF_TXT_2: ”I'll be honest...ugh, long ago, there was...what you can call a civilization of nano robots. Do you know what nano robots are? Good, these nano machines were called the 'Grey Tempest' by their creator
campaign.HF_TXT_3: ”Anyways, the nanomachine and their creator's relations deteroiated over time, and a great war broke out! When the dust settled, only the nano machines survived..“
campaign.HF_TXT_4: The girl gave you a look, as if to observe your expression
campaign.HF_TXT_5: ”But before the creator were destroyed, they managed to close off the only star gate in their star cluster, trapping the nanomachines within“
campaign.HF_TXT_6: ”After that, the nanomachines realized they have more than enough time. They tried in vain for thousands of years to find a way to leave. They tried to experiment with various shapes and forms. For a while, they even recreated the lost civilization of their creator“
campaign.HF_TXT_7: "What does this have to do with you?"
campaign.HF_ST4_2: ”I was the result of the newest experiment. The entire Grey Tempest, or however you call us, have assembled into myself. My will is that of my civilization.“
campaign.HF_ST4_3: ”As for my apperance...It is because I think you might be more accepting to creatures that looks like yourself, and Hanliu also mentioned that white hair is well liked by many people...“
campaign.HF_ST4_4: Ofcourse, I came here to join your fleet and be of service to you. I have to admit, after the recent centuries, I am getting bored of the lonely life, perhaps I should try something new......so, can I join you in your travels?”\n"
campaign.HF_ST4_5: You looked at the first officer next to you, terror filled his face...you have to admit, what you experienced in the past few minute is far to bizarre.
campaign.HF_ST5_2: ”I think we would get along well, and this will be a exciting adventure!“
campaign.HF_ST5_3: As for what to call me... keep it simple. Just call me 'Grey' or 'Greywind.'
campaign.HF_ST5_4: ”um...But the Bureau still need my help, so I'll have one of my doubles to go on an adventure with you! Don't worry, I share all sense and feelings with my double!“
campaign.RZG_Text1: A hooded girl sits in a corner of the bar, looking at a computer. Glimpses of pale-blue hair and an enormous tail suggest that she may have undergone genetic modification or some other experiment.
campaign.RZG_Option1: Try to order a Whiskey and sit across from her.
campaign.RZG_TXT_READY: "You try to chat with the girl, but the girl begin to speak without looking at you"I don't think we know each other, isn't it best to keep your distance?"."
campaign.RZG_TXT_READY_1: Silence hangs between you for a moment. Smiling, the girl produces a data terminal and hands it to you; its dark-blue-and-white casing clearly identifies its faction of origin.
campaign.RZG_TXT_READY_2: Surprised, you immediately begin to suspect that this girl has close ties to the authorities.
campaign.RZG_TXT_READY_3: Put away the terminal and return her friendly smile.
campaign.RZG_TXT_READY_4: Put away the terminal and take the opportunity to touch her tail.
campaign.RZG_STORY_1:
It is clear that the girl is delighted to see you. Although her expression does not show it, her swaying tail gives her away.
 “It seems you are the legend everyone has been talking about, aren't you?”
campaign.RZG_STORY_2: You look at her curiously, about to ask a question.
campaign.RZG_STORY_3: Noticing your curiosity, the girl suggests, “A bar is a good place to find information and opportunities, but not to discuss matters in detail, wouldn't you agree? Be sure to make good use of the terminal I gave you.” With that, she leaves, her tail swaying. Before departing, she orders you a tea, leaving you somewhat puzzled with the blue-and-white information terminal in your hands.
campaign.RZG_STORY_4: You look at the terminal in your hands.
campaign.RZG_STORY2_1: You activate the terminal. Almost immediately, a message window expands to fill your entire field of view.
campaign.RZG_STORY2_2: “Hello. Given how perceptive you are, I expect you have already guessed that I work for the authorities. In that case, I will be direct: on their behalf, I would like to formally invite you to an advanced partnership. Since we are extending the invitation, naturally we will demonstrate the sincerity it deserves.”
campaign.RZG_STORY2_3: The other party's contact information is displayed in enormous, conspicuous lettering.
campaign.RZG_STORY2_4: Accept the offer and try to contact them
campaign.RZG_TXT_2: A moment later, the comm link is established, and the girl's voice comes through from the other side.
campaign.RZG_TXT_3: “I am pleased that you made the correct choice so quickly.”
campaign.RZG_TXT_4: “Mm, regarding the arrangements and terms of this special partnership, I will regularly provide a list of cooperative projects, including but not limited to publicly available test weapons and major shipyard orders. Prices clearly marked, payment on delivery. Well? Tempting, isn't it?”
campaign.RZG_TXT_5: The girl seems slightly nervous and unconsciously leans closer to the screen.
campaign.RZG_TXT_6: “I have left something for you at the port as a gesture of our sincerity. Present this terminal there to collect it.”
campaign.RZG_TXT_7: The girl falls silent for a moment, then gives an awkward smile.
campaign.RZG_TXT_8: “A rather direct attempt to win you over, isn't it? But our offer is sincere, so I hope you won't mind.”
campaign.RZG_TXT_9: After discussing a few more details, you end the communication.
campaign.RZG_TXT_10: Go to the port to collect their gesture of sincerity
campaign.RZG_YB_1: The girl is clearly startled by your action and quickly hides her tail behind her back.
campaign.RZG_YB_2: You quickly realize how rude that was and prepare to apologize, but she gives you no opportunity. After taking a few steps back, she turns and leaves.
campaign.RZG_YB_3: You stand there dumbfounded, suddenly regretting what you did. Still, you remember how fluffy and warm her tail felt...
campaign.RZG_YB_4: You look at the terminal in your hands. You can only hope it contains the answers you seek.
